intent: Fix unstyled Vorn landing page in production; audit + fix all landing pages for similar violations; optimize mobile experience across device classes; ensure no truth drift between website project/game pages and sibling repos; fix the social page to feature the most popular platforms rather than interpretive live activity data; add small social icons to every page's footer; reconcile inconsistent numbers on the membership value breakdown page.
summary: S95 shipped 11 discrete deliverables across two commits — the critical Vorn/Velaxis unstyled-page fix, a new systemic project-info drift detector wired into CI, canonical-truth rewrites for 6 landing pages, 3 new sibling-repo READMEs, a mobile-safety CSS layer that cleared the P0 mobile audit, a CSP meta cleanup sweeper across 106 files, a mobile audit harness, membership-value math reconciliation, a social page restructure per founder intent, footer social icons on all 79 pages, and an agent-memory entry codifying the no-truth-drift rule.
shipped: Vorn + Velaxis unstyled-page bug fix (2-deep asset paths).
scripts/check-project-info-drift.mjs — systemic drift detector; wired into npm run build:check; exposed as npm run drift:check.
Canonical-truth sweep across 6 pages: PromoGrind, Gridiron GM, The Exodus, MindFrame, VaultFront (projects + games), VaultSpark Football GM.
3 sibling READMEs created from PROJECT_BRIEF + SOUL + spec suite: Canon, IdeaForge, The-Living-Protocol.
Mobile-safety CSS layer — mobile audit 2 P0 baseline → 0 P0 across 245 probes.
scripts/csp-meta-cleanup.mjs — removed X-Frame-Options meta + frame-ancestors from CSP meta across 106 files.
tests/mobile-audit.spec.js + scripts/render-mobile-audit.mjs — 5-viewport × 49-page probe with prioritized report.
Membership-value math reconciled — Free $7–15/mo, Sparked combined $27–52/mo, Eternal combined $56–98/mo, 5–10× ratio.
Social page restructure — hero features 8 most popular platforms; interpretive categories removed; remaining channels in single recency-sorted grid.
Footer social icons — all 14 channels, propagated to 79 pages via propagate-nav.mjs.
Agent memory feedback_sibling_repo_truth.md — website agent must pull project copy from sibling-repo README, never hand-write it.
verification: npx playwright test tests/mobile-audit.spec.js (245 probes, 0 P0)
ignisNote: S95 is the kind of session the studio should keep running — systemic fixes (drift detector, mobile audit harness, CSP cleanup sweeper) that turn one-off corrections into reusable guardrails. The founder's truth-drift concern is now enforced in CI instead of relying on review diligence. Mobile P0 is now a measurable blocker, not a subjective call.
blockers: Browser verification backlog grew this session: S95 surfaces (Vorn/Velaxis live styling, social page hero, footer icons, mobile behavior) join the S94 queue (rank strip, exit-intent, IGNIS proof rail). Worth a dedicated browser-verification session.
